notes.title: Performance Update – Reduced VRAM Usage!
notes.notes: I’ve optimized the game's memory usage. VRAM requirements are now significantly lower, fixing previous stuttering and crashing issues on lower-end systems. Enjoy smoother gameplay!

notes.title: v1.04
notes.notes:
Fixed the problem of the car moving after getting out of the car
Added information note about taking furniture
Marks on the map are now visible on the screen You can use the "CTRL" keys

The problem of creating a 2nd new game file when opening the game for the first time will be fixed in future updates
Temporary solution: You can create a new record without any problems after the game area is opened
